questions.q: What is the capital of Tonga?
questions.why: It is on Tongatapu.

questions.q: What kind of government does Tonga have?
questions.why: It is the only kingdom in the Pacific.

questions.q: What is Tonga's currency?
questions.why: Its code is TOP.

questions.q: What did Captain Cook call Tonga?
questions.why: He was welcomed there.

questions.q: Which ocean is Tonga in?
questions.why: It has about 170 islands.

questions.q: Who has been King of Tonga since 2012?
questions.why: He was formerly Prime Minister.

questions.q: Which 2022 volcanic eruption caused a Pacific-wide tsunami?
questions.why: It was the largest eruption this century.

questions.q: Which country is the only Pacific nation never colonised?
questions.why: It was a British protected state but kept its monarchy.

questions.q: Which queen charmed crowds at Elizabeth II's 1953 coronation?
questions.why: She rode in an open carriage in the rain.

questions.q: Which king united Tonga and created its constitution in 1875?
questions.why: He founded the modern kingdom.

questions.q: In which year did Tonga join the Commonwealth as fully independent?
questions.why: It had been a protected state since 1900.

questions.q: Which riots damaged Nuku'alofa in 2006?
questions.why: Much of the town centre burned.

questions.q: Which ancient stone trilithon stands on Tongatapu?
questions.why: It was built around 1200.

questions.q: Which Tongan king was listed as the world's heaviest monarch?
questions.why: He later lost a lot of weight.

questions.q: Which empire did Tonga's rulers lead across the Pacific in the Middle Ages?
questions.why: It reached Samoa and Fiji.

questions.q: Which sport is Tonga's most popular?
questions.why: The team performs the Sipi Tau war dance.

questions.q: Which whales can tourists swim with in Tonga?
questions.why: They breed there from July to October.

questions.q: Which Tongan flag-bearer became famous for wearing oil at the Olympics?
questions.why: He competed in taekwondo, skiing and canoeing.

questions.q: Which bark cloth is a Tongan craft?
questions.why: It is given at weddings and funerals.

questions.q: Which Sunday rule is strict in Tonga?
questions.a: Work and trade are banned by the constitution
questions.why: Even flights are limited.

questions.q: Which island group in the north is a sailing paradise?
questions.why: It has a sheltered harbour.

questions.q: Which earth oven is used for feasts in Tonga?
questions.why: Pigs are roasted whole.

questions.q: Which blowholes on Tongatapu shoot water high into the air?
questions.why: There are hundreds along the coast.

questions.q: Which dance with graceful hand movements is performed by women?
questions.why: Dancers' skin is oiled.

questions.q: Which royal palace in Nuku'alofa is made of wood?
questions.why: It was built in New Zealand in 1867.

questions.q: Which island is the oldest and highest in Tonga?
questions.why: It has rainforest and cliffs.

questions.q: Which Tongan raw fish dish is popular?
questions.why: It is marinated in lime and coconut.

questions.q: Which flying fox bats are sacred in a Tongan village?
questions.why: Only royals may hunt them.

questions.q: Which tombs of the old kings are in Mu'a?
questions.why: They are stepped stone platforms.

questions.q: Which volcano island in Ha'apai has a crater lake?
questions.why: The Bounty mutiny took place nearby.
